verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'observability' only in passing as a hosting/deployment concern (docs-11) and hooks/streaming let you intercept tool calls and partial messages (docs-3, docs-30), but there is no dedicated tracing UI or LLM-call-level trace viewer documented. A hands-on community report explicitly contradicts any built-in observability claim, saying the SDK/CLI harness is 'completely garbage when it comes to displaying full details of tool calls and session management' compared to third-party harnesses like codelayer that expose searchable session timelines (comm-6). missing for 10: a first-party observability/tracing UI, LLM-call-level trace granularity, OpenTelemetry or similar integration, independent confirmation that tool-call tracing works well in practice.
